title: The Top Car
hook: The old Ferris wheel operator had one rule: if a car ever stops at the top after the lights go out... don't bring it down.
lines: The old man who ran the Ferris wheel gave me one rule for closing night.
If a car ever stops at the very top after the lights go out... don't bring it down.
I laughed. Every car was empty. I'd checked them all myself.
At midnight, I pulled the big switch, and the whole fair went dark.
Then, high above me, something creaked.
One car was rocking at the top. Slow. Back and forth.
And a small voice drifted down. Please... I want to get off.
I knew the rule. I stood there in the cold for a long time.
So I pushed the lever. The wheel groaned... and the car came down to me.
Empty. Just the safety bar, still locked... and the seat, still warm.
I climbed in to check under the seat... and the bar slammed shut across my lap.
The wheel began to turn. And far below, at the controls, a little boy in my jacket... waved goodbye.
